description: This file defines the IdempotencyTokenMiddleware class for AWS SDK, which automatically fills request parameters with UUIDv4 tokens for idempotency. It includes methods for generating UUIDs and selecting appropriate random byte generators.

classes.name: IdempotencyTokenMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that auto-fills idempotency tokens in AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware instance that populates operation parameters with idempotency tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, service, and optional bytes generator.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to add UUIDv4 token to the command if required.

methods.name: getUuidV4
methods.description: Generates a UUID v4 string from random bytes.

methods.name: findCompatibleRandomSource
methods.description: Selects the appropriate PHP function for generating random bytes.
